lines.en: I open my long stride; the grass reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 我从金合欢的顶下走过。
lines.en: I walk beneath the crowns of acacia.
My neck sways gently with each step.
My patches break apart in the sunlight.
One step carries me over two bushes.
The dust only reaches my ankles.
I cross the savanna with a steady gait.
I pass, and the grass slowly rises again.
My hooves come down very lightly.
The wind up here is cooler than at ground.
I step around the anthill, not on it.
The treetops ahead look close.

lines.zh: 我抬头，叶子正好在嘴边。
lines.en: I raise my head; the leaves are right there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着一片刺槐叶。
lines.en: I chew an acacia leaf slowly.
My tongue curls around the thorns.
Standing tall, I see far.
Dust far off; maybe a herd.
One ear swivels to a new direction.
I squint toward the savanna's edge.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还留着叶子的涩。
lines.en: The astringency of leaves stays in my mouth.

lines.zh: 脖子上的鬃毛被风吹乱。
lines.en: Wind messes the mane along my neck.
I blink perhaps once in a long while.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上裂成块。
lines.en: My shadow breaks into patches on the grass.

lines.zh: 我嚼完又去够更高一枝。
lines.en: Done chewing, I reach for a higher branch.
It is quiet enough to hear the leaves.
Standing still, I am already tall enough.

lines.zh: 我把脖子垂下来，够一丛矮草。
lines.en: I lower my neck to reach a low patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，躲开一只飞虫。
lines.en: I tilt my head away from a flying insect.

lines.zh: 我的腿有点酸，就多站一会儿。
lines.en: My legs are a little sore, so I stand a while longer.

lines.zh: 草原那边起了风，叶子在翻。
lines.en: Wind rises across the savanna, and the leaves turn over.

lines.zh: 你站在我蹄子旁边，很小。
lines.en: You stand by my hooves, very small.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子弯成弓。
lines.en: I lower my head; my neck bends like a bow.
Did you bring acacia leaves?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你的上方很远。
lines.en: My eyes are far above yours.
Looking up like that will ache your neck.

lines.zh: 我从你的帽顶看到你的鞋。
lines.en: I see from your hat down to your shoes.
I am not afraid; I am only watching.
When you approach, I step back half a pace.
My lashes are longer than your fingers.

lines.zh: 你身上没有草原的味道。
lines.en: You carry none of the savanna's smell.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，把你换个角度看。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see you differently.
You cannot reach the view from up here.
Who touched my hind leg?
I jump once, and it looks awkward.
Twenty-four points; I cannot take many hits.
My neck snaps back.
Pain sends me running for the trees.
My hooves slip on the sand.
I shake my head; my mane is a mess.
That one grazed my shoulder.
I do not cry out; I only pant.
I retreat behind the acacia.
The leaves in your hand are tender.
I only eat from the treetop layer.
Lift it higher; I cannot reach.
I know the sweetness of acacia.
For this mouthful I bend my neck down.
Stand back; I am lowering my head.
I will not snatch it; I only stare.
That scent floats up from three meters below.
I approach your hand slowly.
One bite, and I will walk away.
What you hit was my foreleg.
I am so tall you only reach my knee.
Not too close; I turn slowly.
Your bump made me sway once.
My hoof is coming down right here.

lines.zh: 让一让，我四条腿很占地方。
lines.en: Make room; four long legs take space.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的腿走，会绊到。
lines.en: Walk against my legs and you will trip.
I lean my neck to the other side.
That bump raised the dust.
I am not a wall, but I am heavy.
We swing our necks against each other.
Her patches are a little denser than mine.
We strip the same tree side by side.

lines.zh: 脖子交叠时，我们很安静。
lines.en: When our necks cross, we are silent.
I walk one slow circle around her.

lines.zh: 草原的黄昏替我们守着。
lines.en: The savanna dusk keeps watch for us.
She lowers her head, and so do I.
Our legs weave apart in the grass.

lines.zh: 之后我们还是各吃各的。
lines.en: Afterward we go back to our own branches.

lines.zh: 高的地方，只有我们够得到。
lines.en: Only we can reach the high places.

lines.zh: 你要把我脖子上的叶子拿走？
lines.en: Are you taking the leaves from my neck?
I lower my head so you can reach.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看不清。
lines.en: I cannot make out what you are holding.
Easy; my legs are long and thin.

lines.zh: 我叼起那根枝条还给你。
lines.en: I pick up the branch and return it.

lines.zh: 我的舌头能卷，但不太灵活。
lines.en: My tongue curls, but not very nimbly.

lines.zh: 这枚果子太小，我夹不住。
lines.en: This berry is too small for me to grip.
I set it down beside your hand.
Do not pull at my mane.

lines.zh: 拿走了？那我继续够树顶。
lines.en: Taken? Then I will go back to the treetops.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里压低了身。
lines.en: Something is crouching low in the grass.
My ears turn first.
That shape lies behind the anthill.

lines.zh: 我从高处看得比它清楚。
lines.en: From up here I see it better than it sees me.
I stop chewing and lift my head.
Claws are scraping the sand.
My legs have already gone tense.
Twenty-four points is not much armor.
I fix on that patch of moving grass.
I am ready to run, or to kick.
I raise a foreleg and take aim.
You are under my legs, and that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 一蹄能把你送出去很远。
lines.en: One kick can send you a long way.
My neck pulls back.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，这就是威胁。
lines.en: Standing still, I am the threat.
The grass is too short to hide you.
My hoof is harder than your head.
One rustle of grass tells me.

lines.zh: 从这么高看你，像只蚂蚁。
lines.en: From up here you look like an ant.
After the kick I bolt immediately.
My hind hoof lashes out and tears the grass.
You slide back several meters.
I used only half my strength.
The hoof lands and the dust bursts.
That kick was a warning for you.
I kick, then run for the distance.

lines.zh: 你听见那一声闷响了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that dull crack?
My legs are long, and so is my reach.
Do not come at me from behind again.
On the savanna, hooves speak loudest.

lines.zh: 热带草原上多了四条长腿。
lines.en: Four long legs arrive on the savanna.

lines.zh: 我出生时脖子还没这么长。
lines.en: When I was born my neck was not this long.

lines.zh: 第一眼看到的是金合欢。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was acacia.

lines.zh: 我试着抬头，够到叶子了。
lines.en: I try lifting my head and reach the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹在阳光下刚刚成形。
lines.en: My patches are just settling in the sun.
The grass around me only reaches my feet.

lines.zh: 远处有一群和我一样的影子。
lines.en: Far off, a group of shadows like mine.
I take my first step on unsteady legs.

lines.zh: 风从高处下来，我抬头迎它。
lines.en: Wind comes down from above; I lift my head.
This savanna has room for me to grow tall.
I smell the astringency of acacia.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向最近的那棵树。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the nearest tree.
Fire nears, and my legs move first.
Falling from this height lands hard.

lines.zh: 我只在水边喝水，不该下去。
lines.en: I only drink at the edge; I should not wade.
The blast sets all four hooves stamping.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的长脖子上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my long neck.
Potion fumes numb my tongue.
The treetop leaves have all been stripped.

lines.zh: 雷落在树上，我脖子发烫。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree; my neck feels hot.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，我抬着头。
lines.en: No trees in the void; I lift my head.
